title: GrowSphere Financial Platform
des: Architected a full-stack financial investment & business aggregation portal using Next.js, MERN stack, and Firebase. Features real-time portfolio tracking, multi-tier RBAC security, and dynamic meeting scheduling microservices built for high-concurrency investor workflows.

title: Enterprise E-Commerce Portal
des: Architected an enterprise-grade e-commerce web platform engineered with React, Redux Toolkit, and Node.js backend services. Implemented centralized state management, real-time inventory tracking, secure checkout pipelines, and client-side bundle rendering optimizations.

title: React Enterprise Component Suite
des: Modular software engineering library demonstrating production-grade React architecture patterns, custom state hooks, atomic component isolation, and high-performance DOM reconciliation algorithms across complex web application workflows.

title: Cryptocurrency Analytics Portal
des: Engineered a real-time financial tracking dashboard powered by React and dynamic data visualization engines. Features live price stream feeds, interactive historical market trend analysis, and responsive Web Vitals performance tuning.

title: High-Throughput Subscriber Engine
des: Engineered a modular Node.js/Express RESTful backend microservice integrated with MongoDB for real-time subscriber metric aggregation, database query indexing, and automated data processing pipelines.

title: Enterprise Workforce HRMS System
des: Architected a multi-tenant full-stack workforce management platform leveraging the MERN stack. Features granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), secure authentication pipelines, and optimized MongoDB query indexing for enterprise HR analytics.

title: Streaming Media Platform & Microservices
des: Engineered a high-concurrency video streaming web application leveraging Node.js microservices, MongoDB schema indexing, and a responsive React frontend with custom video playback hooks and real-time user interaction streams.

title: Spring Boot Contact Synchronization Engine
des: Engineered an enterprise Java Spring Boot backend application powered by Spring Security, MySQL relational architecture, and OAuth/Session authentication modules for secure enterprise contact synchronization and access control.
